content: ALOHA, combined with the HLAs and dialogue dataset, achieves a significant improvement on the target character language style retrieval task compared to the baseline open-domain chatbot models. As observed from Table TABREF44, ALOHA achieves a significant boost in Hits@n/N accuracy and other metrics for retrieving the correct response of five diverse characters with different identities (see Section SECREF28).
